about.description: Amelia's Deli has been serving the Alabama Gulf Coast since 1996, located in Gulf Shores, Alabama. Known for hearty sandwiches, creative wraps, fresh salads, and indulgent whole cakes including Black Russian, Red Velvet, Hummingbird, and Iced Lemon Pound Cake. They also offer sandwich platters and boxed lunches for events and meetings.
about.elevator_pitch: A Gulf Shores institution since 1996, Amelia's Deli crafts legendary sandwiches and show-stopping whole cakes that make it the go-to lunch spot on Pleasure Island.
about.vibe: Casual, local, welcoming Gulf Coast lunch spot
about.insider_tip: Order a whole cake with at least 3 days notice — the Black Russian chocolate cake with vodka and Kahlua is a must-try.
